text:
Maya S.: quick heads-up — we're rolling a coordinated docs + SDK compatibility change tomorrow morning. This is a breaking rename: `request_stream` -> `response_mode` across generated clients and examples.

Tim R.: is the hosted API changing immediately or are we doing a grace period?

Maya S.: hosted will accept `request_stream` for 30 days with a deprecation header `X-Redwood-Deprecation: response_mode` and a warning in the response body. After 30 days we'll return 400 for that param. Migration guide will be published now and linked here.

Olga P.: can we add a runtime compat layer in the SDKs so customers get a smoother migration?

Samir K.: yes — I put draft PRs up for js-sdk and py-sdk that accept both keys but emit console warnings / logs. PR links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/234 (draft) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/178 (draft).

Maya S.: plan:
- today: final docs + migration guide, codemod examples, update examples in api-ref
- tomorrow 02:00 UTC: publish docs site, run search reindex (see command below)
- +30 days: hard reject old param on hosted API

Command to reindex:
```
make docs-build && ./scripts/reindex-search --push --env=prod
```

Codemod example (quick sed for JS):
```
# replace request_stream with response_mode
find docs -name "*.md" -exec sed -i '' 's/request_stream/response_mode/g' {} +
```

Tim R.: do we need a customer email / support banner?

Maya S.: yes — draft email is at https://confluence.redwoodinc/KB/SDK-migration-draft (please review). Support banner for the hosted dashboard will go up during the publish window and support playbook is attached to the confluence doc.

Olga P.: note for the release notes: call out code samples that change, and add a short paragraph for platform teams about pinning model/client versions.

Samir K.: adding unit + integration tests to the SDK PRs, target merge timestamp ~1835005000. I'll also add an automated codemod in the js-sdk repo that runs in CI when customers bump major versions.

docs-bot: Published docs build #456 to prod, search reindex queued for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC, redirect rules for old examples in place.

Maya S.: thanks all — after docs are live I'll post a short announcement in #general and ping Sales + CS for account outreach. :rocket: 

Tim R.: awesome, thanks Maya + Samir.

Olga P.: lgtm from docs side, will monitor support channel during rollout.

Samir K.: will follow-up with PR updates and a short changelog snippet to paste into the release email.
